page.overview:
Who is Pterov?

Pterov was a minor character who appeared in Mortal Kombat: Conquest series in the episode entitled “Festival Of Death”. He was portrayed by Joe Candelora.

Pterov was a villager who sought to help his friend Fahrak in finding his brother, who was kidnapped by the Festival of Death. After they and a couple of their fellow villagers found the Festival's stagecoach they stopped it and ordered them to give back Fahrak's brother. T Two Festival members then emerged from the coach and killed Pterov and the others.
